REQUIRED_INFORMATION: A street address with a house number, or a cross street or landmark a crew can find
An address that exists in the County address file and lies in Sarasota County
One problem per request; a second problem needs its own request
Where the water is (yard, road, meter box) and whether it runs continuously
Where the water comes up in the road and how much is flowing
Whether the whole house or one fixture is affected, and since when
Whether neighbors are out too, and whether the meter has a lock or notice
What the meter problem is: leak, damage, blank display, reading or bill
What is wrong with the curb stop: leaking, stuck or broken
Where the device is and what it is doing: leaking, spraying or noisy
The symptom (backup, overflow, odor) and whether it is inside or outside the house
Where the odor comes from: a manhole, a cleanout or inside the house
The lift station name or number, or the street it is on
Where the pipe is broken and whether sewage is flowing
What the reclaimed water problem is: no pressure, leak or water quality
